product_family: Static Code Analysis (SAST), IDE plugins (VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio), code snippets platform, and coding assistant. Codiga was acquired by Datadog on April 4, 2023, with standalone products shut down May 4, 2023.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: Codiga blog (March 1, 2022) states it 'has achieved SOC 2 Type I compliance in accordance with American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) standards for SOC for Service Organizations also known as SSAE 18' and 'was audited by Prescient Assurance.' An 'unqualified opinion on a SOC 2 Type I audit report' is claimed.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found; only SOC 2 Type I documented.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found in Codiga's security or trust documentation. ISO 27001 is held by parent company Datadog, not Codiga independently.

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found for Codiga. ISO 27017 compliance is held by Datadog, not Codiga independently.

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found for Codiga. ISO 27018 compliance is held by Datadog, not Codiga independently.

certifications.name: ISO 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found for Codiga. ISO 27701 Processor certification is held by Datadog, not Codiga independently.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found for Codiga. Datadog offers HIPAA compliance with BAA, but Codiga does not explicitly advertise HIPAA compliance.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance Statement
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR is not explicitly mentioned in Codiga's privacy policy. Policy notes international data transfers with employee/contractor consent but lacks formal GDPR compliance language.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Codiga does not hold PCI DSS; payment processing is handled by Stripe, which is PCI DSS Level 1 certified. This is Stripe's cert, not Codiga's.

privacy.ai_training_note: Explicit statement in Code Privacy policy: 'We NEVER keep your code in our infrastructure, nor use end user code to train our system.' Source: https://www.codiga.io/code-privacy/
privacy.data_region: AWS US (implied; no explicit region specified)

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Credentials stored encrypted; no plaintext credential storage

security.name: Source Code Storage
security.value: Code collected for analysis only; deleted immediately after analysis completion. Never stored in Codiga infrastructure.

security.name: Code Retrieval
security.value: Retrieved directly from GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket at time of analysis; never persisted in Codiga systems

security.name: Payment Processing
security.value: Stripe (PCI DSS Level 1 certified). Codiga does not store credit card information.

products.name: Static Code Analysis (SAST)
products.data_scope: Source code analyzed in real-time; deleted after analysis. Code not stored.
products.notes: Supports Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and other languages. Checks for OWASP 10, MITRE CWE, Sans/CWE Top 25 violations. Real-time analysis in IDE and CI/CD.

products.name: IDE Plugins
products.data_scope: Code analyzed locally and via IDE integrations. Not persisted in Codiga systems.
products.notes: Available for VS Code, JetBrains (IntelliJ, PyCharm, etc.), and Visual Studio. Plugins still appear available on marketplaces despite May 2023 product shutdown.

products.name: Code Snippets Platform
products.notes: Platform at code-snippets.dev for sharing and searching code snippets.

products.name: Automated Code Reviews
products.data_scope: Review comments generated from analysis; not stored.
products.notes: Integrated into GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket workflows. Autofix capability for vulnerabilities.

products.name: Coding Assistant (Rosie)
products.data_scope: Analyzed via IDE; not persisted. Note: Status unclear post-acquisition.
products.notes: AI-powered coding suggestions. Originally named 'Rosie'. Fate under Datadog integration unknown.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium subscription (specific pricing not found; free IDE plugins, paid services mentioned but rates not disclosed)
compare.data_residency: AWS US (no option for EU residency documented)

flags: Codiga acquired by Datadog on April 4, 2023; product status post-acquisition ambiguous
Standalone Codiga products officially shut down May 4, 2023; codiga.io website remains live with 'has joined Datadog' banner
SOC 2 Type I certification dated March 1, 2022 (pre-acquisition); unclear if cert validity extends post-integration or if Datadog certs now apply
Security documentation last updated June 21, 2021 (before acquisition announcement)
No Data Processing Agreement (DPA) publicly available despite Privacy Policy existing; GDPR compliance posture unclear
The website advertises code analysis tools, but standalone products are shut down; integration into Datadog's SAST platform may involve different data handling than standalone Codiga did
Identity note: Codiga is now a subsidiary/product of Datadog, Inc. (public company, NASDAQ: DDOG). Certifications may need to reference parent company.
AI training posture contradicts some competitor practices (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Atlassian); Codiga is explicit no-training commitment
